last.verdict: Teva's three growth brands drove another raised sales outlook, but profit guidance barely moved and generic lenalidomide sales are shrinking.

takeaways.label: Brands carry growth
takeaways.text: Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy together brought in about $1.1 billion, up 33%. Austedo hit $751 million (+21%), Ajovy $269 million (+61%), Uzedy $85 million (+96%).

takeaways.label: Sales outlook raised again
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue guidance rose to $16.7–17.0 billion from $16.5–16.85 billion. Austedo guidance is now $2.55–2.65 billion, and Ajovy and Uzedy targets also went up.

takeaways.label: Profit outlook barely moves
takeaways.text: Operating profit guidance's top end was trimmed to $3.9 billion from $4.0 billion, and the EPS range stays about $1.92–2.11. Higher sales are not yet lifting profit.

takeaways.label: Generics drag, margins improve
takeaways.text: Total revenue fell 2% to $4.4 billion on lower generic lenalidomide sales. Adjusted gross margin still rose to 58.7%, and adjusted EPS grew 10% to $0.86.

history.verdict: Stronger brand-drug sales and raised guidance outweighed a profit miss.

reasons.label: Austedo outlook raised
reasons.text: 2026 Austedo sales guidance lifted to $2.45–2.6 billion; U.S. sales up 33%.

reasons.label: Revenue guidance raised
reasons.text: 2026 revenue outlook raised to $16.5–16.85 billion on Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy.

reasons.label: Miss blamed on deal
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of 2 cents missed; Emalex acquisition cost about 61 cents per share.
